answer: Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 20 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in echo and zephyr lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the mesa graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1071 impostors cost 1799 times the honest price and take 18 times as long to clear. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
